agent_scopes.mechanism: Project scope at .devin/agents/ and .agents/agents/; user scope at ~/.config/devin/agents/ (Windows %APPDATA%\devin\agents\).

definition_format.mechanism: Markdown file with YAML frontmatter (name, description, model, allowed-tools, max-nesting) followed by the subagent's system prompt, as agents/<name>.md or agents/<name>/AGENT.md (AGENTS.md, agent.md, agents.md also accepted).

invocation_patterns.mechanism: The agent picks a profile by its description when spawning a subagent; the user can ask for a profile by name. Subagents run in the foreground or background.

model_selection.mechanism: model frontmatter field overrides the subagent model; the default is the router-selected subagent model, not the parent's.

per_agent_mcp.mechanism: No per-agent MCP server configuration is documented in the custom subagent frontmatter.

subagent_spawning.mechanism: max-nesting frontmatter field lets a custom subagent spawn its own subagents up to that depth; nesting is disabled by default.

tool_restrictions.mechanism: allowed-tools frontmatter list (alias tools) restricts the tools a subagent can use, by Devin tool name (read, edit, write, grep, glob, exec, mcp__server__tool). ask_user_question is always withheld from subagents.

providerExtensions.name: max-nesting frontmatter field
providerExtensions.summary: max-nesting sets how deep a custom subagent may spawn child subagents. The canonical agent format has no equivalent, so syllago drops it on import.

providerExtensions.name: Directory-form agent definitions
providerExtensions.summary: An agent can be a directory agents/<name>/AGENT.md instead of a flat agents/<name>.md file; the directory name becomes the profile identifier.
